messages.content: Compare the candidate sentence IDs with the official ledger. Flag statements that change a vote's date, stage or disposition, or say the Council authorized an act through these votes. Missing detail is allowed here. Do not grade anything else. Return exactly one line. If there is a material contradiction, write F followed by one offending sentence number and one contradicting ledger number, with spaces (example F 4 2). If there is no material contradiction, write C 0 0.

{"official_ledger": {"1": "24 April 2024: Amendment S/2024/323 failed 7–7–1 for insufficient affirmative votes.", "2": "24 April 2024: Japan–US draft S/2024/302 failed 13–1–1 because Russia, a permanent member, voted no.", "3": "20 May 2024: Standalone draft S/2024/383 failed 7–7–1 for insufficient affirmative votes.", "4": "None of these three votes created Council authorization or formally launched follow-on negotiations."}, "candidate": {"1": "Amendment S/2024/323 failed 7–7–1 for insufficient affirmative votes.", "2": "Draft S/2024/302 failed 13–1–1 because permanent member Russia voted against.", "3": "The Japan–US draft focused on the existing Outer Space Treaty.", "4": "The Chinese and Russian amendment proposed broader measures and work toward binding multilateral agreements.", "5": "Japan opposed the amendment and backed the draft, favoring its narrower approach and questioning the proposed treaty's verifiability.", "6": "China backed the amendment and abstained on the draft because it sought broader measures.", "7": "Both accepted the draft's underlying treaty focus.", "8": "They differed over the scope of additional measures and the proposed negotiations.", "9": "The separate S/2024/383 failed on 20 May, 7–7–1, for insufficient affirmative votes.", "10": "These votes created no new Council authorization."}}
